result.title: HypTI: Hyperbolic Geometry-Aware Multimodal Feature Fusion Framework for Dementia Detection Based on Tabular-Image Data
result.summary: AI-assisted dementia detection usually requires multimodal fusion of diverse data, such as clinical tabular assessments and neuroimaging data. However, most existing approaches perform feature fusion in Euclidean space. This overlooks the geometric structure of representation, including hierarchical organization in clinical assessments and multi-scale anatomical patterns in neuroimaging data. Recent studies have proved hyperbolic space provides a natural geometry for modelling hierarchical and multi-scale structures due to its exponentially expanding space. Motivated by these, we propose HypTI, a hyperbolic geometry-aware multimodal fusion framework for dementia detection based on clinical tabular assessments and MRI scans. HypTI extends hyperbolic representation learning to an underexplored tabular-MRI setting, jointly modelling clinical tabular, MRI scans, and cross-modal interactions in hyperbolic space. Specifically, clinical tabular variables are represented through learnable Lorentz prototypes to capture hierarchical relationships among assessments, while MRI scans are encoded using ROI-guided multi-scale representation learning to capture anatomical patterns across brain regions and spatial scales in Lorentz space. The multimodal representations are integrated through an adaptive fusion module generates subject-specific scale and shift coefficients to dynamically modulate and integrate the multimodal embeddings, enabling effective patient-level tabular-image representation learning for dementia detection. Experiments on OASIS-3 dataset show that the proposed framework achieves strong performance compared with representative approaches.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HypTI，在双曲（Lorentz）空间中融合临床表格与 MRI 数据：以可学习原型表示表格变量的层级关系，用 ROI 引导的多尺度编码刻画脑区解剖模式，再经生成个体化 scale/shift 系数的自适应模块完成融合，用于痴呆检测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用双曲几何承载层级与多尺度结构、并以 scale/shift 调制实现跨模态融合」的做法，可能为 LVR 中多尺度视觉证据的层级化组织与 latent 状态融合提供表示几何上的线索，尚需核查其适配推理期状态的可行性。
